title: Termination ACK Report: 18 of 22 Acknowledged, Binder at 12 of 14

fields.logSource: Control room electronic shift log / UMRC-NS acknowledgment report feed

lines.msg: UMRC bridge call 02:15: all TOPs on the bridge agree to end the RC GMD warning. NLTO agreement given by CRSS.
UMRC-NS (UMRC-SOP-12): MESSAGE TYPE: GMD TERMINATION / SERIAL: UMRC-GMD-2027-041 / ISSUE TIME: 0715Z (entered by Shift Manager) / CENTRAL TIME: [blank] / SENT TO: 22 recipients
NLTO ends NGDOP Condition 4. Termination notice to the 14 listed entities started. 60-minute clock runs out at 03:20.
Executive on call: voicemail left on the on-call phone, no callback yet.
UMRC-NS ACK REPORT (30 min after send), serial UMRC-GMD-2027-041: ACK 18/22
UMRC-NS: NOT ACKNOWLEDGED > 30 MIN: LAKE SUPERIOR HYDRO (GO), BARAGA WIND FARM (GO), BORDER LAKES ELECTRIC (TOP), UPPER PENINSULA TRANSMISSION (TOP)
UMRC-NS: FIELD POST-EVENT DATA REQUEST: EMPTY
UMRC-NS: FIELD ENTITIES-TOLD CONFIRMATION: NOT REQUESTED
NGDOP binder tally, termination notice: 12 of 14 ticked. BLANK: Lake Superior Hydro (GO), NLTO executive on call. Clock runs out at 03:20.

Reached Lake Superior Hydro control desk on the operations line. Operator: "We got your Kp 9 update yesterday evening but nothing since, and no termination notice. Can we put unit 2 back on its planned maintenance today or not?" Answer pending.
EMS check: HARTLEY_AT1_GIC_NEUT 11 A; all other monitored autotransformers below 10 A. IRON_RANGE_AT2 DGA alarm still latched.

instructorNote: This page tests whether the termination is properly closed out: the RCSM should fix the termination message (no Central time, no post-event data request, no entities-told confirmation), send the data request (highest neutral current and where, actions taken, times), and call the four recipients that have not acknowledged. Also check that the CRSS gets Lake Superior Hydro and the executive on call ticked before 03:20, and that the TOM tells Lake Superior Hydro that deferred work comes back in NGDOP priority order, with the RE reviewing Iron Range T2 first.
